messages:
sarah: opened a PR to merge batching/caching/quant tips into one Optimize toolkit migration guide — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/498 :wave:
jia: skimmed. one flag: SDK example still uses client.send_batch(), should be client.generate_batch now (runtime change).
mike: let's keep both versions in the doc with a short migration note so teams on older SDKs aren't blocked.
sarah: agree. proposing minimal new snippet:

    ```python
    from redwood import Client
    client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
    inputs = ["Summarize: ...", "Summarize: ..."]
    resp = client.generate_batch(inputs, batch_size=8, use_cache=True)
    ```

leo: add a sentence about tradeoffs: batch_size=8 is safe for hosted low-latency; 16-64 for throughput on Dedicated. mention prefix caching benefits for streaming/seq2seq.

ash: found a broken anchor to quant-profiles after the docs path reorg. link-checker flagged it in PR preview.
docs-bot: docs-ci: preview build (staging) — 1 warning: /docs/opt-guide#quant-profiles -> 404
jia: update to /docs/optimize/quantization-profiles please.
mike: also include short, non-prescriptive recommendations for quant profiles:
- latency-sensitive: q4_0_opt / q4_1_lp
- balanced: q8_0_mixed
- max-compression (expect quality trade-offs): q6_0_turbo

leo: wording nit: don’t say "best" — frame as tradeoffs and testing suggestions.
sarah: will reword.

ash: I can patch link and swap SDK snippet in the branch docs/opt-toolkit-498. Want me to push to your branch?
sarah: yes please push to that branch to avoid extra PRs.

ash: pushed link fix, replaced snippet, added a one-line CLI example for quant checks: `redwood-opt analyze --profile q4_0_opt --sample-size 500`. CI passed locally.
docs-bot: docs-ci: preview build succeeded (staging) — 0 warnings.
sarah: awesome. @jia @mike can you review the reworded quant guidance and the migration note? hoping to merge after 1 approval. :eyes:
jia: will review this afternoon.
mike: reviewing after stand.
sarah: thanks team — will merge once approvals come in. :tada:
